name: רֶסֶן
summary: Resen is a city between Nineveh and Calah, “the great city”. It is spelled as the noun רֶסֶן “bridle”, but the relationship between the two words is unknown.

evidence.note: The phrase בֵּין נִינְוֵה וּבֵין כָּלַח gives Resen’s location between the two named cities.

note: Moved from the name word of the former word entry `raesaen`; the common noun רֶסֶן “rein, bridle” is now in the root entry רסנ. Its Aramaic cognate arc-t00858 (רִסְנָא, bridle) goes with the noun, not the city.
